summary.title: Build a C#/WPF RPG
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build a text-based RPG in C# using WPF/XAML, following a lesson-by-lesson tutorial series that covers MVVM, quests, combat, XML data, and saving.
keywords: learn c# by building a game
takeaways: How to structure a WPF/XAML game using a ViewModel and PropertyChanged notifications
How to model locations, monsters, items, quests, and trading in C# classes
How to move game data into XML files and add unit tests
How to implement combat, saving/loading, and player creation in a WPF app
How the project was later refactored to .NET 5 with a multi-project layout
summary.summary: This page is the table of contents for a multi-part tutorial that rebuilds a Windows Form RPG as a new WPF/XAML game. The lessons are grouped into preparation, planning, programming, refactoring, unit testing, XML-based game data, combat, save/load, customizable player attributes, .NET 5 upgrades, and UI improvements. The page lists lesson titles only, so the actual code walkthroughs are not included in the text provided.
